author: PC Gamer
text:
Machinarium AI tribute cops a flogging from studio: 'This looks disgusting and has nothing to do with us or our craft'
Three cheers for the slop intolerant.

author: PC Gamer
text:
CD Projekt boss pays tribute to BioWare for helping bring The Witcher to life 20 years ago: 'BioWare has been a massive part of CDPR history'
BioWare let CD Projekt use the Aurora Engine for its breakout RPG, and then helped them show it off at E3.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Modern Warfare 4 players declare 'broken' on DMZ perk that lets you self-revive after full death
Some hate that you can't know an enemy's truly dead in DMZ.

author: PC Gamer
text:
It gives me great nerdly joy that the Next Fest demo on Steam's 100 most-played games list is a shopkeeping sim
(Don't worry, you don't need to be a sim geek to dig it.)

author: PC Gamer
text:
Everyone gets a free ticket to World of Warcraft: Forever today as Blizzard stress tests the servers ahead of launch day
Get a taste of what it's like to compete with hundreds of other players to finish a quest.

author: PC Gamer
text:
With BioWare dead, EA lays out its 'next chapter,' and it's pretty much as predicted: Guns and football are fine, and everything else is under the microscope
The changes predicted when Saudi Arabia's PIF bought Electronic Arts are coming true.

author: PC Gamer
text:
RIP BioWare: EA has shut down the legendary RPG developer
Bloomberg also reports that EA is cutting "around 400 jobs" across the company.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nearly $1 million worth of PSA-graded Pokémon and other trading cards have been stolen right outside PSA's headquarters
Refunds will be issued to affected parties.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GOG taken offline for maintenance in wake of PHP security emergency
GOG and GOG Galaxy were taken offline following news of critical web vulnerabilities.

author: PC Gamer
text:
US government leaks the best GTA 6 promo yet: Pißwasser is real
Rockstar appears to be teaming up with a Florida brewery to bring two of GTA's most famous beer brands to life.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Black Friday gaming mouse deals
Black Friday is a-coming and the deals wheels will are already rolling in earnest.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Don't get hit with the BIOS update hammer for COD MW4 like my colleagues—here's how to ensure you can play multiplayer and DMZ
TPM and Secure Boot requirements strike again.

author: PC Gamer
text:
AMD has shipped FSR 4.1 early for RX 6000 graphics cards, and it's coming to Ryzen APUs, Vulkan, and Xbox too
Better support is always a good thing.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'You've taken us free cash flow negative as a company, so congratulations': Amazon has plenty of Nvidia GPUs, but not enough energy to power its AI boom
Meanwhile, the RTX 5090 remains missing in action.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I've played 2 of Dawn of War 4's campaigns, and they're everything I hoped they'd be
We're so back, baby!

author: PC Gamer
text:
80% of Samsung's data center memory is already sold for 2027, meaning yet another double-digit price increase for RAM expected and more likely to come
Next year isn't looking so hot for sensibly priced hardware upgrades either…

author: PC Gamer
text:
110 million votes later Nurse Harrow has finally made it into Deadlock, with special thanks to a particularly dedicated player who 'cast exactly 1,000 votes for her'
Nurse Harrow voters did, however, prove themselves to be of the most skilled players.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'We expect mass attacks to start within 15 minutes of the release': Web admins braced for emergency PHP updates to plug leaked high-severity holes
Batten down the virtual hatches.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Chinese repair centre has received 7 melted 12+4-pin Nvidia GPUs in just the past two days alone
This is not getting better, is it?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Here's another gizmo to prevent your graphics card from melting - wouldn't it be nice if 12+4-pin connectors weren't a cause for concern at all?
I'm thankful for accessories like this, but I wish it wasn't my problem to sort in the first place.

author: PC Gamer
text:
In this age of pervasive slop maybe we should be grateful for Shrek 2 Remastered
Or maybe not.

author: PC Gamer
text:
EA Sports FC 27 gets a PEGI 16 rating in Europe because of loot boxes
Still rated E for Everyone by the ESRB, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'If you can’t show your game to the world without fearing it’ll be cloned, something’s broken' says Moonlighter studio on its canceled demo
Opus 5.5 continues to wreak havoc among independent devs.

author: PC Gamer
text:
My favorite indie roguelike action RPG is tempting me to come back with a transformative new update inspired by Diablo seasons
Hell Clock's Journey of Miracles update changes the entire game like a new Diablo season, but it won't ever expire.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The studio behind Life is Strange, Jusant, and Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is desperately struggling to stay afloat
Don't Nod has begun "safeguard proceedings" to protect itself from creditors and says up to 85 employees are at risk of being let go under its new restructuring plan.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After talking to Capcom, I'm a lot more optimistic about Onimusha 3 getting a remaster
We need time-traveling Jean Reno on PC.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Founder of bankrupt Samson studio mulls how to use AI for his next attempt: 'Cutting corners in game development has a habit of coming back to bite you in the ass'
Christopher Sundberg said the goal for his next studio is to make "a game we can afford to finish without needing every sales forecast to come true."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Helldivers 2 studio warns mods may break as it switches to new anti-cheat, and the negative reviews are dropping on Steam like Hellbombs
Arrowhead says Easy Anti-Cheat will be more effective in combatting recent cheat mods, but the change has resulted in more than 1,000 negative user reviews on Steam in a single day.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I played 20 cozy game demos in Steam Next Fest and these 5 made it onto my wishlist
I swear they aren't all farm sims.
